# S498 paper alignment audit (decisive)

## Verdict

The S432/S480/S493 actual `FrobenioidPresentation` is NOT paper Example 3.2
C_v^vdash.  It is a generic model with a constant N divisor monoid that is
independent of q_v.

## Evidence

* `example32Phi` has obj := constant `stageDivisorialAddMonoid` and identity
  pullback.  It contains no q_v, no q_v^(1/2l), no N log_Phi(q_v), and no
  ramification transition.  Two different q_v or bad places give the same Phi.
* Paper Phi_{C_v^vdash} is generated by the image of q_v / N log_Phi(q_v) and
  is a submonoid of the p_v-adic Phi_{C_v}; the constant standalone N model
  cannot equal it.
* Paper `C_v^vdash` is a split Frobenioid with characteristic splitting tau;
  the current object is only a `FrobenioidPresentation`, no tau, no split
  structure.
* Paper base `D_v^vdash = B(K_v)^0` has a full-subcategory/left-adjoint
  relation to the tempered category D_v; repo has no such relation.

## Consequence

The current `rationalFunctions`/divisor/Input/presentation are actual Lean
objects, but they are objects for the wrong Phi.  They are candidate/local
model objects, not paper C_v^vdash.

## Corrected requirements

1. Build the ambient p_v-adic Frobenioid Phi_{C_v} and the q_v image; then
   Phi_{C_v^vdash} = N log_Phi(q_v) submonoid.
2. Build rational functions L^x with paper pullback and the actual q_v
   normalized valuation family (existence/uniqueness still missing).
3. Build the characteristic splitting tau = pi^N and split Frobenioid.
4. Prove base/carrier/Phi/rationalFunctions/Frobenioid equivalences to paper.

Until these are done, do not use the constant-N model as paper Example 3.2.
